findings.rationale: After lstat, Linux open uses O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK. This fresh source-bound Linux job passed symlink, same-inode-target symlink swap, FIFO, FIFO-swap, short-read and size-boundary checks. The combined native/capture suite passed 12/12 with zero skips.
findings.conditions: This is a scoped native Linux descriptor boundary, not proof against privileged same-inode writers or all timestamp semantics.
